# E0217: alternatives bind different names

Each alternative of a `|` pattern binds the same names, so the arm's body can use them whichever one matched. Give the bindings one name.

- Rule: [`patterns.or-patterns`](../../reference/09-patterns.md#patterns.or-patterns)
- Reported at: the alternative.
- Tier: `core`, checked in the `types` phase

## Example

This program makes the mistake:

```stilt E0217:5
type Shape = | Circle(radius: f64) | Square(side: f64)

fn size(s: Shape) -> f64 {
  match s {
    Circle(r) | Square(side) => r
  }
}
```

This one is fixed:

```stilt
type Shape = | Circle(radius: f64) | Square(side: f64)

fn size(s: Shape) -> f64 {
  match s {
    Circle(r) | Square(r) => r
  }
}
```

## What the compiler prints

`stilt check` on [`E0217_alternatives_bind_different_names.lt`](../../tests/diagnostics/E0217_alternatives_bind_different_names.lt):

```text
── ALTERNATIVES BIND DIFFERENT NAMES ── E0217_alternatives_bind_different_names.lt:5:17  [E0217]

This alternative binds different names from the first:

  5 │     Circle(r) | Square(side) => r
    │                 ^^^^^^^^^^^^

Each alternative of a `|` pattern binds the same names, so the arm's body can
use them whichever one matched. Give the bindings one name.
```
